metadata.title: PESA 1996: Jharkhand Debate | झारखंड में पेसा पर बहस | Live
metadata.description:
PESA 1996 is a crucial legislation meant to safeguard tribal culture and rights. However, the law is not implemented in Jharkhand, and the state continues to debate its enforcement. 
A national workshop on this very issue is being held today in Ranchi.

Watch the workshop live

#tribal #jharkhand
